name: Central KY Nats Warm-Up 2023
information: Due to limited space, each competitor is limited to 1 guest. We will be making a group pizza order the day before the competition (Friday, July 21). **Please read the Pizza Order tab before you register.** 3x3 finals are tentative and contingent on the competition running on schedule. If megaminx finals finish before 4:00 PM, 3x3 finals will be held.
